title: From Casual to Pathological: Characterizing Sports Betting in Germany
summary: The goal of the project is to investigate why some individuals who engage in sports betting develop problematic betting behavior, while others do not. Additionally, it looks at what distinguishes individuals who engage in sports betting from those who primarily participate in other forms of gambling or do not engage in gambling at all. The investigation will be conducted through an online survey.

interventions.name: Singular group consisting of indidivuals of at least 18 year of age who are living in Germany. People who participate in sports betting are included as well as those who do not.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
- Living in Germany
Exclusion criteria:
- Living outside of Germany
- Lack of ability to understand German
- Lack of ability to consent
